items.title: Nabizada’s breakaway solo stunner edges Watford past Southampton
items.summary: Southampton will have to get used to being barracked as they travel the Championship this autumn, the Spygate team are set to be everyone’s favourite boo-boys in the second tier. Certainly that was the case in Hertfordshire, with Watford fans and players alike beside themselves after a hard-fought victory, decided by two memorable first-half goals. Watford paid tribute to Kenny Jackett before the match, the one-club legend and local boy hailed with two minutes of applause. As everyone clapped, the cameras remained stubbornly focussed on Tonda Eckert in the dugout. The Southampton manager has the potential to become a pantomime villain as this season unspools. Remaining under investigation by the FA for his part in the Spygate affair, and with the prospect of a potentially heavy sanction to follow, Eckert’s fate has cast uncertainty over his side’s prospects this season and given opponents added motivation. Continue reading...

items.title: End of an era? South Korea’s sun sets in the Premier League but Japan rise
items.summary: After glory days of Park Ji-sung and Son Heung-min, the new season could be Korean-free for first time since 2005 It has been a cruel summer for South Korea. The national team crashed and burned at the World Cup, the police are investigating the football association, reports have emerged about bribes paid to foreign referees in 2011 and 2012 and there is a real prospect of the English Premier League being Korean-free for the first time since 2005. That was when Park Ji-sung signed for Manchester United, to start a love affair between the Land of the Morning Calm and England’s top tier that has continued ever since. Park won four titles and his mantle was taken over in 2015 by Son Heung-min at Spurs. Continue reading...

items.title: Un ancien de Charleroi, champion d'Italie, en route vers l'Arabie Saoudite pour remplacer un ex-Ballon d'or ?
items.summary: Al-Hilal cherche à se débarrasser de Karim Benzema afin d'attirer Victor Osimhen. Mais il ne suffira pas que d'écarter l'ancien Ballon d'or pour que le deal se fasse. Encore faudra-t-il convaincre et le joueur et son club actuel, Galatasaray.

items.title: Vitor Bruno hoopt dat spelers op goede manier reageren na eerste nederlaag: "Het moet pijn doen"
items.summary: Na 5 ongeslagen wedstrijden is de eerste nederlaag toch een feit voor Anderlecht onder Vito Bruno. Op het veld van Beveren kon paars-wit geen nederlaag afwenden en werd het 1-0 voor de promovendus.

items.title: Westerlo-spelers reageren teleurgesteld na verlies tegen Genk: "Het is geen mentaal of fysiek probleem"

items.title: Vitor Bruno relativise : "Je veux que ça fasse mal à mes joueurs, puis qu'ils réagissent"
items.summary: Les joueurs d'Anderlecht étaient abattus après la défaite à Beveren. Vitor Bruno, de son côté, relativisait, bien conscient que ce premier résultat négatif devait bien finir par arriver.

items.title: Brüls verrast na glansprestatie tegen Anderlecht: "Ze zijn de beste van België"

items.title: Bryan Heynen heeft duidelijk antwoord klaar op kritiek die Racing Genk kreeg
